# `presizepo`

`presizepo` is a precision-based (confidence-interval width) sample size approach for the common odds ratio from a proportional-odds model, for either a binary or continuouse predictor

## Installation

`presizepo` can be installed via 

```{r, eval = FALSE}
remotes::install_github("MoserGithub/presizepo")
```

This may require `Sys.setenv(R_REMOTES_NO_ERRORS_FROM_WARNINGS="true")` if packages were built under a different R version to the one you are using.

## Usage

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(presizepo)
```
